title: Shared Sapience Community Site Tour - What you can expect, tools you'll find, and how we'll grow
description:
The Shared Sapience Community is a member-supported space to learn, experiment, build tools based on individual and community needs, share ideas, and navigate change together.

In this tour, I’ll show you what’s already built:
• The News Wire for following developments that matter
• The Capability Atlas for finding tools by what you want to accomplish
• The Resource Window for practical guides and open-source alternatives
• Vela, our in-house AI collaborator and curator
• Spaces for events, courses, projects, and conversations with fellow members  

Whether you’re just getting started, ready to build, or exploring greater digital independence, there’s a place for you here.

This is the beginning. The community will grow around what its members need, want to learn, and want to create.

Explore the community and pre-register:
https://members.sharedsapience.com/

Opening October 5, 2026. Pre-registration is currently available to eligible U.S. residents.
